data: Partner marketing shouldn’t come with a support queue that leaves you guessing. Whether you’re a growing brand or a publisher on the network, our team is ready to help you find an answer — fast. Get help with your FuseTwo account, your platform integration, or your program — direct from the team that runs it.
Email support@fusetwo.com for help with your account, your integration, tracking, payouts, or anything else related to your FuseTwo program. We respond within one business day.
Already working with a FuseTwo account manager? Reach out to them directly. They know your program and can usually move faster than a general support request.

FuseTwo will only contact you from a @fusetwo.com address. We’ll never ask for your password, request upfront payment, or ask for deposits over email or messaging apps. Forward anything suspicious to support@fusetwo.com.
Jump to setup and troubleshooting guidance for your platforms.

FuseTwo connects to your Shopify store through our app in the Shopify App Store. Most setup questions come down to installing the app, connecting your FuseTwo account, and confirming tracking is live on your storefront.
If something isn’t working as expected, email support@fusetwo.com with your store URL and we’ll take a look.

FuseTwo integrates with BigCommerce to track affiliate and partner-driven orders back to your store. If you’re setting up the integration for the first time or troubleshooting attribution, email support@fusetwo.com with your store details.
The FuseTwo plugin for WooCommerce connects your store to your FuseTwo program for tracking and attribution. For install help, plugin questions, or troubleshooting, email support@fusetwo.com.
Questions about using the FuseTwo plugin on a WordPress site can go to support@fusetwo.com.
How do I contact FuseTwo support?
Email support@fusetwo.com. Include your account details and, if relevant, your store URL or platform — it gets you a faster answer.
